invariants.rationale: The method returns an object, so result should not be null under normal conditions.
config is input to the method and should be non-null for correct operation.
metaClient is input to the method and should be non-null for correct operation.
The resulting HoodieTable is created for the provided metaClient, so its getMetaClient() should return the input metaClient.
The resulting HoodieTable is created for the provided config, so its getConfig() should return the input config.
